summary: Short tree-lined kerb with houses 13-15 m away on its own side.
reasons: Cars park here; trees shade kerb

best_section.where: West kerb of Moorak Street, opposite the grassy park

drivers.seclusion: Two dwellings 13-15 m away on the same side, apartments 38 m; park on the far side.
drivers.access_and_room: Short 12 m kerb under trees; cars park along it, so a van fits.
drivers.traffic: Collector-type street, moderate traffic; cars park both sides.
drivers.convention: Resident-permit 2P signs; parked cars along both kerbs.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb, mainly from the east and south.
